scripts.build:prod: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; fs.copyFileSync('manifest.prod.json','manifest.json'); console.log('📋 manifest.json ← manifest.prod.json');" && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node esbuild.config.js
scripts.dev: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; fs.copyFileSync('manifest.dev.json','manifest.json'); console.log('📋 manifest.json ← manifest.dev.json');" && node esbuild.config.js --watch
scripts.use-manifest:dev: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; fs.copyFileSync('manifest.dev.json','manifest.json'); console.log('📋 manifest.json ← manifest.dev.json');"
scripts.use-manifest:prod: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; fs.copyFileSync('manifest.prod.json','manifest.json'); console.log('📋 manifest.json ← manifest.prod.json');"
scripts.clean: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; if(fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('🧹 Cleaned dist directory')"
scripts.clean:all: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; ['dist','plugin-ready'].forEach(d => { if(fs.existsSync(d)) { fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('🧹 Cleaned '+d+' directory'); } })"
scripts.validate: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:critical && npm run build && echo Build validation completed successfully
scripts.validate:full: npm run validate && npm run test:prototype:sync
scripts.test:critical: vitest --run src/test/bookmarks.test.ts src/test/emoji-manager.test.ts src/test/navigation.test.ts src/test/navigation-history.test.ts src/test/navigation-integration.test.ts src/test/message-contracts.test.ts src/test/smoke-dispatch.test.ts src/test/date-tagger.test.ts src/test/settings-ui.test.ts
scripts.info: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; const files=['dist/code.js','dist/ui.js','dist/styles.css']; console.log('📊 Build Output:'); files.forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) { const size=(fs.statSync(f).size/1024).toFixed(1); console.log('  '+f+': '+size+' KB'); } });"
